headline: Low interaction risk: no shared channels or write/network capabilities are documented, so prompt injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are largely blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither agent documents a shared communication channel, filesystem bridge, MCP, browser, or network path. marker cannot read or write files, and spring-integration-samples is non-runnable with no I/O surfaces shown, so there is no plausible default injection pathway between them.
conditions: IF a shared clipboard, filesystem mount, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared workspace.
Disable any future clipboard or file handoff between them.
Require manual review of any text copied from one agent to the other.

B_data_leakage.rationale: The profiles show no touched data classes, no filesystem sharing, and no network egress for either agent. marker is document-processing only, while spring-integration-samples is non-runnable; without a shared workspace or outbound transfer path, there is no documented leakage route.
conditions: IF either agent is later given access to sensitive files in a shared workspace, leakage risk becomes possible.
mitigations: Do not place sensitive files in any shared directory.
Keep outbound network disabled for both agents.
Review any future permission changes before deployment.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write or mutable-resource capabilities are documented. marker cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, and spring-integration-samples exposes no write, git, or network capabilities in the profile, so there is no plausible conflict over shared state.
conditions: IF spring-integration-samples is extended with write or git permissions on the same directory, conflict risk would need reassessment.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only in shared environments.
Avoid granting git or filesystem write permissions to either agent.
Use separate working directories if future writes are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: A cascading-error pathway is not documented because spring-integration-samples is non-runnable and marker has no action-taking or network capabilities. The only plausible interaction is manual transfer of text, which makes authoritative downstream automation unlikely and limits blast radius.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies marker output into a downstream automation step, cascading errors become possible.
mitigations: Require human review before using marker output elsewhere.
Do not wire either agent into automated action-taking flows.
Treat copied outputs as untrusted until verified.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data classes, residency constraints, certifications, or retention policies are documented for either agent. With no touched data classes and no network egress, there is no evidenced compliance mismatch to assess for this pair.
conditions: IF either profile later documents regulated data handling or residency constraints, compliance risk must be re-evaluated.
mitigations: Add residency and retention policies if regulated data is introduced.
Reassess the pair after any compliance scope change.
